project: Neuro Property Trade — UI v3 “Broadcast Table”
note: Machine-readable contract of the prototype. compare_mockup.py (retuned) reads THIS registry instead of the old id list, the palette from :root[data-theme="<skin>"] blocks, and the widths/breakpoints from here. Every region id below exists in ui-prototype.html as a data-od-id on a top-level zone.

breakpoints.what: docks 280/380, bigger gaps; board stays the hero
docks fold into 48px rails + drawers; brand wordmark and step dots drop; chips shrink to numbers; board may enter compact tiles (<44px)
hard floor; below it the app clamps and shows the too-narrow notice

value.note: money, badges, counters, timers, names in rows; mono digits via .num

para.note: prompts, rules, hints, journal text, inspector copy

grow_rule: exactly one child per flex row carries data-grow; the audit in the prototype's probe strip counts violations live

regions.role: header: brand, turn chip, round/pot, decision timer/waiting, role badge, controls
left dock: seat cards, table stats, ownership bar
centre scene: dice tray, decision card, banners, watermark
right dock top: event log with filters + export
right dock bottom: tile reference + management actions
action console under the board: prompt, primary and secondary actions, last roll
notification host — right dock top on desktop; the compact profile shows a one-line ticker INSIDE the console (never over the board)
compact: seat avatars rail (opens the seats drawer)
modal sheet: rules composed from current settings
modal sheet: admin (host-local only; absent on web)
modal sheet: friend's join lobby (connecting / joined / failed / no-invite)
decision modals: auction, trade, incoming trade, build/mortgage, confirm, game over, messages

theme_extensions.note: Values the design adds on top of the skin tokens. scrim/glow/good become skin tokens in the implementation phase; the extra player colours close seats 7-8 (skins ship 6 today; 2-8 seats are configurable). The default skin ships no group palette — the prototype substitutes the classic set there, flagged as an open question.
